meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline: 检索公开的单细胞与空间转录组数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在做单细胞或空间转录组研究想直接从公开图谱获取数据
copy.tagline_en: Query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data on demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study single-cell biology and want to query public transcriptomics atlases directly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Python 查询公开的 CELLxGENE Census 单细胞与空间转录组数据，按细胞类型、组织等筛选，产出可交给 scanpy 分析的 AnnData 对象。
howto.when: 当你要按细胞类型、组织或疾病查询 Census 的元数据与表达切片时触发；Census 汇总计数、空间数据及跨数据集比较也归它管。分析本地数据请改用 scanpy。

say.text: 打开 2025-11-08 版 Census，查一下脑组织里的细胞类型有哪些
say.note: 返回该版本脑组织的细胞类型列表

say.text: 取一份肺的 B 细胞表达数据，只要 CD4、CD8A 两个基因
say.note: 返回含这两个基因的 AnnData 切片

say.text: 统计各组织的细胞数，只算原始数据
say.note: 返回按组织分组的细胞计数

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query public CZ CELLxGENE Census single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data with Python—filtering by cell type, tissue or disease—and return AnnData objects for scanpy analysis.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need Census cell metadata, gene expression slices, summary counts or spatial data; for your own local data use scanpy or anndata.

say_en.text: Open the 2025-11-08 Census and list the cell types in brain tissue
say_en.note: Returns cell types for brain in that release

say_en.text: Pull lung B cell expression for just CD4 and CD8A
say_en.note: Returns an AnnData slice with those two genes

say_en.text: Count cells per tissue, counting primary data only
